exercises.explanationUz:

  a salt mine = tuz koni
  a chamber = katta xona (yer
     ostida)
  a chapel = kichik cherkov,
     ibodatxona
  a well = quduq
  a miner = konchi
  deeply religious = chuqur dindor


⚠ 'A MINE':

  = kon (yer osti).
  ⚠ 'mine' (olmosh) = meniki -
  boshqa so'z!
  ⚠ 'to mine' = kon qazimoq.


⚠ 'TO DIG OUT':

  = qazib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'is DUG out' - MAJHUL NISBAT
  (9-unit mavzusi!).
  ⚠ dig - dug - dug.


⚠ 'THE SURFACE':

  = yuza, sirt.
  ⚠ 'below the surface of the
  ground' = yer yuzasi ostida.


⚠ 'A CHAMBER':

  = katta xona, zal (rasmiy/eski).
  ⚠ 'chamber music' = kamer musiqa.


⚠ 'A CHAPEL':

  = kichik cherkov.
  ⚠ 'a church' - katta cherkov.


⚠ 'COAL':

  = ko'mir.
  ⚠ 'a coal mine' = ko'mir koni.


⚠ 'RELIGIOUS':

  = dindor.
  ⚠ 'religion' = din.
  ⚠ 'deeply' = chuqur (darajasi).

tasks.en: A Hidden World of Wonders
Near Cracow, in southern Poland, is the Wieliczka Salt Mine. Not much can be seen above the surface, but visitors are taken down into a hidden world of natural and man-made wonders.
tasks.uz: Polsha janubidagi Krakov yaqinida Wieliczka tuz koni joylashgan. Yer yuzasida ko'p narsa ko'rinmaydi, lekin tashrif buyuruvchilar tabiiy va inson yaratgan mo''jizalarning yashirin dunyosiga olib tushiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'can be seen', 'are taken' - MAJHUL nisbat.
⚠ 'hidden' = yashirin.
⚠ 'man-made' = inson yaratgan.

tasks.en: According to a 700-year-old legend, a princess called the Blessed Kinga threw her ring into a salt mine at Marmaros in Hungary. While travelling from Marmaros to Cracow, she stopped at Wieliczka and her servants were told to dig a well.
tasks.uz: 700 yillik afsonaga ko'ra, Muborak Kinga ismli malika uzugini Vengriyaning Marmaros shahridagi tuz koniga tashlagan. Marmarosdan Krakovga sayohat qilayotganda u Wieliczkada to'xtagan va xizmatkorlariga quduq qazish buyurilgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'according to' = ... ga ko'ra.
⚠ 'a legend' = afsona.
⚠ 'a servant' = xizmatkor.
⚠ 'were told to dig' - majhul.

tasks.en: Instead of water, salt was discovered - and in the first lump of salt which was taken out, Kinga's ring was found!
tasks.uz: Suv o'rniga tuz topilgan - va chiqarilgan birinchi tuz bo'lagida Kinganing uzugi topilgan!

tasks.en: The legend is just a story - but it is true that for over seven centuries salt has been mined from the rock below the town of Wieliczka. [1 - C] The salt used to be dug out by hand, and until 1620 it was carried up to the surface by the miners.
tasks.uz: Afsona - shunchaki hikoya, lekin yetti asrdan ortiq vaqt davomida Wieliczka shahri ostidagi tog' jinsidan tuz qazib olingani haqiqat. [1 - C] Tuz qo'lda qazib olinardi va 1620 yilgacha konchilar uni yuzaga olib chiqishardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'for over seven centuries' = yetti asrdan
ortiq.
⚠ 'has been mined' - present perfect majhul.
⚠ 'rock' = tog' jinsi.

tasks.en: After that date, horses were used to carry the salt out, but the work was still very dangerous and many miners were killed or injured. The constant danger made the miners deeply religious and chapels were constructed underground where church services were held.
tasks.uz: O'sha sanadan keyin tuzni olib chiqish uchun otlardan foydalanilgan, lekin ish baribir juda xavfli edi va ko'p konchilar halok bo'lgan yoki jarohatlangan. Doimiy xavf konchilarni chuqur dindor qilgan va yer ostida cherkov xizmatlari o'tkaziladigan ibodatxonalar qurilgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'constant' = doimiy.
⚠ 'church services' = cherkov xizmatlari
(ibodat).
⚠ 'to hold a service' = ibodat o'tkazmoq.

tasks.en: After a chapel was destroyed by fire in 1697, miners were not allowed to take wooden statues into the mine, so they began to carve sculptures from rock salt.
tasks.uz: 1697 yilda bir ibodatxona yong'inda vayron bo'lgandan keyin konchilarga yog'och haykallarni konga olib kirish taqiqlangan, shuning uchun ular tosh tuzdan haykallar o'yishni boshlagan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'was destroyed by fire' - majhul + sabab.
⚠ 'were not allowed to' = ruxsat berilmagan.
⚠ 'wooden' = yog'ochdan.
⚠ 'a sculpture' = haykal.

tasks.en: Nowadays visitors are shown how salt was mined long ago, and can see the enormous chambers which have been dug out of the solid rock. They can also see pretty green lakes, and chapels with beautiful carvings. [2 - B] There are also 250 kilometres of tunnels and underground caves with huge salt crystals in strange shapes.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi kunda tashrif buyuruvchilarga uzoq o'tmishda tuz qanday qazilgani ko'rsatiladi va ular qattiq tog' jinsidan qazib olingan ulkan zallarni ko'rishi mumkin. Ular yana chiroyli yashil ko'llar va go'zal o'ymakorlikli ibodatxonalarni ko'rishi mumkin. [2 - B] Bundan tashqari, 250 kilometr tunnellar va g'alati shakldagi ulkan tuz kristallari bilan yer osti g'orlari bor.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'nowadays' = hozirgi kunda.
⚠ 'solid rock' = qattiq tog' jinsi.
⚠ 'enormous' = ulkan.

tasks.en: A special attraction is the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga, which was made by the miners themselves in a chamber 100 metres underground. [3 - A] The walls and floor of the chapel, as well as the lovely statues it contains, have been carved from rock salt.
tasks.uz: Alohida diqqatga sazovor joy - Muborak Kinga ibodatxonasi; uni konchilarning o'zlari yer ostida 100 metr chuqurlikdagi zalda yasagan. [3 - A] Ibodatxonaning devorlari va poli, shuningdek undagi go'zal haykallar tosh tuzdan o'yilgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'by the miners THEMSELVES' - o'zlari.
⚠ 'as well as' = shuningdek.
⚠ 'have been carved' - present perfect majhul.

tasks.en: You will be amazed by these unforgettable sights, which should definitely not be missed by any visitor to the Cracow area.
tasks.uz: Siz bu unutilmas manzaralardan hayratga tushasiz - Krakov hududiga kelgan har qanday tashrif buyuruvchi ularni albatta o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.

⚠ 'unforgettable' = unutilmas.

tasks.en: Uluru might just be the most photographed rock in the world. This beautiful, enormous rock is located in Uluru National Park, 450 kilometres from Alice Springs in Australia.
tasks.uz: Uluru dunyodagi eng ko'p suratga olingan tosh bo'lsa kerak. Bu go'zal, ulkan tosh Avstraliyada, Alis-Springsdan 450 kilometr uzoqlikdagi Uluru milliy bog'ida joylashgan.

tasks.en: The rock was first seen by Europeans in 1872 and was discovered by Ernest Giles. It was called Ayers Rock until 1985 when it was given back to the Anangu Aborigines. They are deeply religious people and the giant rock is very special to them. That's why it's now called Uluru, which means 'The Centre of the Earth'.
tasks.uz: Toshni yevropaliklar birinchi marta 1872-yilda ko'rgan va u Ernest Jayls tomonidan kashf etilgan. U 1985-yilgacha Ayers Rock deb atalgan, o'sha yili u Anangu aborigenlariga qaytarib berilgan. Ular chuqur dindor odamlar va ulkan tosh ular uchun juda alohida. Shuning uchun u endi 'Yerning markazi' degan ma'noni anglatuvchi Uluru deb ataladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ PARA 2 - Historical Facts.
⚠ Past majhul: was discovered, was called, was given back.

tasks.en: Uluru is surrounded by very flat land, so the giant rock can be seen from far away. People are always amazed by its beautiful orange colour and they enjoy exploring its small caves that contain fascinating carvings and drawings. Visitors who climb to the top of Uluru also get a fantastic view of the countryside.
tasks.uz: Uluru juda tekis yer bilan o'ralgan, shuning uchun ulkan toshni uzoqdan ko'rish mumkin. Odamlar uning go'zal to'q sariq rangidan doim hayratda qolishadi va qiziqarli o'yma va chizmalar bo'lgan kichik g'orlarini kezishdan zavqlanishadi. Uluru tepasiga chiqqan tashrif buyuruvchilar atrofning ajoyib manzarasidan ham bahramand bo'lishadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ PARA 3 - Things to see/do there.
⚠ 'is surrounded by', 'are always amazed by', 'can be seen'.

tasks.en: Uluru is certainly one of nature's most dramatic and beautiful sights. It should not be missed by any visitors to the Australian Outback.

tasks.note:

MAJHUL NISBAT - 9-UNITNING ASOSIY
GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TO BE (kerakli zamonda) + 3-ShAKL

  Present Simple:  am/is/are + taken
  Past Simple:     was/were + carried
  Present Perfect: has/have been +
                   mined
  Future:          will be + amazed
  Modal:           can/should be +
                   seen

  ⚠ Zamonni 'BE' ko'rsatadi, asosiy
  fe'l HAR DOIM 3-shaklda.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ACTIVE → PASSIVE                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ACTIVE:  Fire destroyed a chapel.
           (ega)  (fe'l)  (to'ldiruvchi)
  PASSIVE: A chapel was destroyed
           by fire.
           (ega)    (fe'l)   (agent)

  1) Active to'ldiruvchisi →
     passive egasi
  2) Fe'l → be + 3-shakl (zamon
     saqlanadi)
  3) Active egasi → 'by' + agent
     (yoki tushiriladi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QAChON IShLATILADI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HARAKAT muhim, KIM qilgani muhim
  emas yoki noma'lum:

  'Salt WAS DISCOVERED.'
  (kim topgani muhim emas)

  ⚠ 'by' + agent faqat agent MUHIM
  bo'lganda: 'was destroyed BY FIRE'.


⚠ 8b JAVOBI - AGENTSIZ GAPLAR:

  'Visitors are taken down' - kim
     olib tushishi muhim emas
  'Salt has been mined there' -
     konchilar - aniq, aytish shart
     emas
  ⚠ Agent NOMA'LUM, AhAMIYaTSIZ yoki
  ANIQ bo'lsa tushiriladi.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN:

  Majhul nisbat o'zbekchada '-il/-in'
  bilan: 'topildi', 'qurilgan',
  'olib tushiladi'.


⚠ 'AN AGENT':

  = harakatni bajaruvchi.
  ⚠ 'the appropriate tense' = mos
  zamon.

tasks.en: The statue was designed by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi. It was started in 1876 and finished in 1884. It is made of copper with iron supports. It was a gift to the Americans from the French to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the American Declaration of Independence. The statue was made in sections; in June 1885 it was put into 214 boxes and shipped to New York, where it was reassembled in four months. It was declared a national monument in 1924.

tasks.en:
The Pyramid of the Sun

The Pyramid of the Sun might just be the most impressive pyramid in the Americas. This enormous pyramid is located in the ancient city of Teotihuacan in Mexico. It has hundreds of steps that lead up to the site of an old temple.

The pyramid was built by the Teotihuacanos and was completed in AD 200. It is made of earth and red rock and it was used for religious reasons. The ancient city was first found by the Aztecs many centuries later.

Visitors can climb up the steps to the top of the pyramid and admire the wonderful view. From the top, two other pyramids and an ancient road can be seen.

The Pyramid of the Sun is certainly one of the most fascinating sights in Mexico. It should not be missed by any visitors to the country.
tasks.uz:
Quyosh piramidasi

Quyosh piramidasi Amerikadagi eng ta'sirchan piramida bo'lsa kerak. Bu ulkan piramida Meksikadagi qadimiy Teotiuakan shahrida joylashgan. Unda eski ibodatxona joyiga olib chiqadigan yuzlab zinalar bor.

Piramida teotiuakanliklar tomonidan qurilgan va milodiy 200-yilda tugatilgan. U tuproq va qizil toshdan qurilgan va diniy maqsadlarda ishlatilgan. Qadimiy shaharni ko'p asrlar keyin atsteklar birinchi topgan.

Tashrif buyuruvchilar zinalardan piramida tepasiga chiqib, ajoyib manzaradan bahra olishlari mumkin. Tepadan yana ikkita piramida va qadimiy yo'lni ko'rish mumkin.

Quyosh piramidasi, shubhasiz, Meksikadagi eng qiziqarli manzaralardan biri. Mamlakatga tashrif buyuruvchilar uni o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Read this sentence. What does it mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gapni o'qing. U nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A THING DONE WELL':
  = yaxshi bajarilgan ish.
  ⚠ 'want sth DONE' - majhul ma'no:
  ish BAJARILIShINI xohlasang.

⚠ 'DO IT YOURSELF':
  = o'zing qil.
  ⚠ 'DIY' = do-it-yourself (uy
  ta'miri).

tasks.en: If you want a thing done well, do it yourself.
tasks.uz: Ish yaxshi bajarilishini xohlasang, o'zing qil.

sentencePatterns.formula: A [narsa] is a place where [gap].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A salt mine is a place where salt is dug out from below the ground.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tuz koni - tuz yer ostidan qazib olinadigan joy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'where' - nisbiy olmosh (joy).
⚠ 'is dug out' - majhul nisbat.

sentencePatterns.formula: A [odam] is someone who [gap].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A miner is someone who works underground.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Konchi - yer ostida ishlaydigan odam.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Nima] was destroyed by [sabab] in [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A chapel was destroyed by fire in 1769.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ibodatxona 1769 yilda yong'inda vayron bo'ldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: According to [manba], [gap].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: According to a 700-year-old legend, a princess threw her ring into a salt mine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 700 yillik afsonaga ko'ra, malika uzugini tuz koniga tashlagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Nima] was/were + 3-ShAKL (by [kim]).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Chapel was made by the miners themselves.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ibodatxona konchilarning o'zlari tomonidan yasalgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Nima] has/have been + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The walls have been carved from rock salt.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devorlar tosh tuzdan o'yilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: You will be + 3-ShAKL by [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You will be amazed by these unforgettable sights.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu unutilmas manzaralardan hayratga tushasiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] is/are + 3-ShAKL (by [agent]).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Prague is admired for its lovely buildings.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Praga go'zal binolari uchun sevib tomosha qilinadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] was/were + 3-ShAKL by [agent].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Pyramids were built by the ancient Egyptians.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Piramidalar qadimgi misrliklar tomonidan qurilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] can/should/will be + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Great Wall of China can be seen from space.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buyuk Xitoy devori koinotdan ko'rinadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What is/are [nima] made of? - It's/They're made of [material]. Where was/were it/they made? - In [davlat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What are these shoes made of? - They're made of leather. Where were they made? - They were made in Italy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu oyoq kiyim nimadan yasalgan? - Teridan. Qayerda ishlab chiqarilgan? - Italiyada.

sentencePatterns.formula: Who was [nima] + 3-ShAKL by? - It was + 3-ShAKL by [kim].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who was America discovered by? - It was discovered by Christopher Columbus.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Amerikani kim kashf etgan? - Uni Kristofer Kolumb kashf etgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: When was it + 3-ShAKL? - It was + 3-ShAKL in [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was it discovered? - It was discovered in 1492.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qachon kashf etilgan? - 1492 yilda.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Nima] is located in [joy]. It was designed by [kim] and completed in [yil]. It is made of [material]. It was built as [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Parthenon is located in Athens. It was designed by Ictinus and Callicrates and completed in 432 BC. It is made of marble. It was built as a temple.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parfenon Afinada joylashgan. Uni Iktin va Kallikrat loyihalagan, mil. av. 432 yilda bitirilgan. Marmardan. Ibodatxona sifatida qurilgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Muzeyning ish vaqtini ayta olasizmi?

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kichkina suv parisi Kopengagenda joylashgan va Daniyaning milliy ramzi.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Piramida teotiuakanliklar tomonidan qurilgan va milodiy 200-yilda tugatilgan.
